claims.text: Original neo-renaissance features such as huge arched doorways and stained glass windows have been restored or faithfully recreated.

findings.quote: Original neo-renaissance features such as the huge arched doorways and stained glass windows have been restored or faithfully recreated

claims.text: On Andrássy Avenue, the hotel sits beside luxury boutiques.

findings.quote: Located on the most prominent avenue in town, Andrássy Avenue (a UNESCO heritage site), the hotel rubs shoulders with luxury boutiques

claims.text: The hotel is close to the old Jewish quarter, known for its synagogue and street art.

findings.quote: close to the old Jewish quarter, famed for its magnificent synagogue and impressive street art

claims.text: The courtyard has a glass ceiling.

findings.quote: beneath the glass ceiling of the courtyard

claims.text: The Black Swan Penthouse Suite has a black marble bar wrapped in wallpaper by Adam Ellis Studio.

findings.quote: The Black Swan Penthouse Suite features an opulent black marble bar featuring luxury spirits and it includes a dedicated bartenders for any bespoke cocktails. The bar is wrapped in bespoke wallpaper by Adam Ellis Studio

claims.text: The W Suites represent the ballet Swan Lake and face the Hungarian Opera House.

findings.quote: W Suite
Torn between a beautiful interplay of black and white, all ten of these rooms represent the famous ballet Swan Lake and face the Hungarian Opera House

claims.text: AWAY Spa has an aromatic steam room, a Finnish sauna and a Beauty Bar.

findings.quote: Get your wellness on in our aromatic steam room, the Finnish sauna or the Beauty Bar.

claims.text: With Omorovicza, AWAY Spa offers a mineral-powered treatment collection inspired by Hungary's thermal baths.

findings.quote: In partnership with Omorovicza, AWAY® Spa introduces a mineral-powered treatment collection inspired by Hungary’s legendary thermal baths

claims.text: Le Petit Beefbar serves premium beef and comfort food with Parisian brasserie vibes inside the Drechsler Palace.

findings.quote: Discover Le Petit Beefbar, our restaurant in Budapest where premium beef, bold comfort food, and Parisian brasserie vibes meet in the historic Drechsler Palace

claims.text: Music curator David Ráday curates the hotel's THE WARM-UP and AFTER DARK programs.

findings.quote: Budapest-born David Ráday (aka Raasa) is the sound behind W Budapest’s cultural pulse
David curates signature programs like THE WARM-UP and AFTER DARK

claims.text: The seasonal outdoor terrace has views of the Budapest Opera House.

findings.quote: Seasonal Outdoor Terrace with views of the Budapest Opera House

claims.text: The Historical Rooms have arches on columns with carved-in sculptures and original ornament ceilings.

findings.quote: Historical Rooms
Arches lean on columns with carved-in sculptures and original ornament ceilings

claims.text: W Budapest is in the historic Drechsler Palace on UNESCO-listed Andrássy Avenue, opposite the Hungarian Opera House.

findings.quote: set in the historic Drechsler Palace on UNESCO-listed Andrássy Avenue, opposite the Hungarian Opera House

claims.text: AWAY Spa is an underground retreat inspired by the city's thermal bath culture.

findings.quote: Inspired by the city's thermal bath culture, AWAY Spa is a subterranean retreat

claims.text: The White Swan and Black Swan Penthouse Suites have private balconies with views of the Hungarian State Opera House.

findings.quote: Enjoy this breathtaking view from your own private balcony in the White Swan and Black Swan Penthouse Suites.

claims.text: The hotel's design pays homage to chess, with black and white grid patterns from shower tiles to lift floors.

findings.quote: Chess is one of Hungary's most popular pastimes and one that the hotel's design pays frequent homage to: once you notice the black and white grid pattern, you'll see it everywhere, from shower tiles to the lift floors

claims.text: The fifth floor has a wood-centric style that highlights the palace's original and restored roof design.

findings.quote: The fifth floor has a unique wooden-centric style that highlights the Palace's original and restored roof design.

claims.text: For Opera House views from a standard room, ask for a front-facing room.

findings.quote: Standard doubles are elegantly kitted out in rich shades of blue and chrome, with floor-to-ceiling windows (ask for a front-facing room for impressive views of the Opera House)

claims.text: The surrounding area is a mix of glamour and grunge.

findings.quote: this area is a mix of glamour and grunge

claims.text: The hotel is aimed at music lovers and party-goers, with on-property parties and headliner DJs.

findings.quote: perfect choice for music lovers and party-goers, with multiple on-property parties and headliner DJs bringing nights to life
